item.title: US scallop landings continue to skew small as 2025-26 season nears end
item.description: Freezer inventories of premium, large all-natural IQF scallops remain thin, and size distribution continues to skew smaller, limiting flexibility across specifications -- Lorin Castiglione, UCN senior price analyst

item.title: Trident’s SVP of international on way out
item.description: The senior vice president of Trident's international operations is leaving the company, having joined three years ago after a 29-year career at Cargill

item.title: Alva rejoins Del Pacifico as sales, marketing VP
item.description: 'It feels like a genuine homecoming -- I was one of the original gangsters who helped lay the foundation for this incredible company' -- Danny Alva, Del Pacifico Seafoods

item.title: Sea Harvest triples earnings in 2025 as hake catches rebound, pricing surges
item.description: The South African fishing company recorded one of its best-ever financial years in 2025, with robust catches and higher prices for hake driving earnings

item.title: Open Blue ends commercial cobia farming operations, switches to R&D model
item.description: The announcement ends a decade-long effort to make the Panamanian cobia farm profitable as a commercial entity

item.title: Red Lobster CEO taps former colleagues, P.F. Chang’s execs to reshape executive team
item.description: The Orlando, Florida-headquartered company announced Monday that it has named Brad Hill as chief financial officer and executive vice president, transformation, alongside Kristen Briede as chief global development officer

item.title: Canadian salmon farmers shred prices to clear out product glut
item.description: 'There's just a lot of fish coming to market at once. Demand hasn't fallen off, but when supply runs ahead of what buyers need week to week, prices feel it. Fish isn't necessarily piling up long-term' -- senior UCN price analyst Lorin Castiglione

item.title: The Market Current: China, EU’s almost 100,000t pollock fillet trade discrepancy
item.description: UCN's latest Market Current video covers the discrepancy of nearly 100,000t between China's frozen pollock fillet exports and EU imports

item.title: Outgoing Cermaq manager says Grieg employees favored in takeover
item.description: An internal memo has revealed Cermaq's decision to eliminate several director-level personnel amid its absorption of Grieg Seafood's assets in Canada and Northern Norway, which it acquired last year

item.title: Former Sealord CEO to take over at King & Prince Seafood
item.description: Former Sealord chief executive Steve Yung will succeed Michael Alexander as president and CEO of King & Prince Seafood, marking a planned leadership transition at the Nissui-owned US coated seafood supplier
